title: Amosis
summary: Amosis is named in Cory, Ancient Fragments (1876, ed. Hodges), with a reign length or synchronism. Display only.
description: Added from the Cory import. Display only. Cory gives reign lengths and synchronisms, not a BC year this record can sort on, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year (Cory is display-only and gives none).

reign.note: pending CFAH reference (no CFAH anchor point or Table 1 entry found for this)

reign.date: “Amosis, who lived about the same time with Inachus the Argive”
reign.citation: Cory, Ancient Fragments (London: Reeves & Turner, 1876, ed. E. Richmond Hodges), p. 146; Ptolemaeus Mendesius, ap. Clement of Alexandria, Stromata, ap. Eusebius, Praeparatio Evangelica, book 10
reign.note: He overthrew the city of Avaris. Not Amos of the eighteenth dynasty. The word about is printed.
